note_en: The particle 着 after a verb shows that an action is ongoing or its result remains: 上面写着“我错了，别生气啦” "on it was written 'I was wrong, don't be mad'" (the words are there and stay there); 我拿着手机 "I'm holding my phone"; 哥哥靠着墙站着 "my brother was standing leaning against the wall." 着 often describes a background state against which the main action happens: 总是笑着说 "always said, laughing."
